text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and water gives you energy and keeps you strong. Regular exercise, like walking or swimming, helps your heart and reduces stress. Getting enough sleep is also important, because your body needs rest to work well. Mental health matters too, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Try to keep a good work-life balance by spending time with family and friends, and by doing things you enjoy. Small healthy habits every day can make a big difference in your life.
